macros.name: DTLandlast
macros.doc: Placed between two names when the list contains more than two names.

macros.name: DTLbibdatefield
macros.doc: Used for fields that have dates (Date and UrlDate).

macros.name: DTLBIBdbname
macros.doc: Placeholder command set by \DTLloadbbl that should expand to the name of the databib database containing the bibliography data.

macros.name: DTLbibdoi
macros.doc: This is used to format the DOI field.

macros.name: DTLbibdoitag
macros.doc: Expands to the textual tag used at the start of \DTLbibdoi.

macros.name: DTLbibeprints
macros.doc: This command is used to format the Eprints field.

macros.name: DTLbibfield
macros.doc: Gets the value assigned to the field ⟨field name⟩ for the current row of \DTLforeachbibentry.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldcontains
macros.doc: Checks if the value of the bib field given by ⟨field label⟩ contains ⟨sub string⟩.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldexists
macros.doc: This tests whether the field with the given label exists and is not null for the current entry.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldiseq
macros.doc: Checks if the value of the bib field given by ⟨field label⟩ is equal to ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldisge
macros.doc: This tests whether the value of the field given by ⟨field label⟩ is lexicographically greater than or equal to ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldisgt
macros.doc: Checks if the value of the bib field given by ⟨field label⟩ is greater than ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldisle
macros.doc: Checks if the value of the bib field given by ⟨field label⟩ is less than or equal to ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLbibfieldislt
macros.doc: Checks if the value of the bib field given by ⟨field label⟩ is less than ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: DTLbibitem
macros.doc: Used at the start of each bibliography item within \DTLbibliography.

macros.name: DTLbibliography
macros.doc: Displays the bibliography for the database ⟨bib dbname⟩ which must have previously been loaded using \DTLloadbbl.

macros.name: DTLbibliographystyle
macros.doc: Sets the bibliography style.

macros.name: DTLbibpubmed
macros.doc: This is used to format the PubMed field.

macros.name: DTLbiburl
macros.doc: Used to format the Url field (which should already be detokenized).

macros.name: DTLbiburldate
macros.doc: Used to format the UrlDate field.

macros.name: DTLcite
macros.doc: This is analogous to \cite[⟨text⟩]{⟨label-list⟩}, but writes the \citation command to ⟨mbib⟩.aux instead of to the document’s main auxiliary file.

macros.name: DTLcomputewidestbibentry
macros.doc: This computes the widest bibliography entry over all entries satisfying ⟨condition⟩ in the database ⟨db-name⟩, where the label is given by ⟨bib-label⟩, and the result is stored in ⟨cs⟩, which may then be used in the argument of the thebibliography environment.

macros.name: DTLendbibitem
macros.doc: Hook to add extra information at the end of a bibliography item.

macros.name: DTLforeachbibentry
macros.doc: Iterates through the database called ⟨db name⟩ and does ⟨text⟩ if ⟨condition⟩ is met.

macros.name: DTLformatabbrvforenames
macros.doc: The format of an author/editor’s abbreviated forenames.

macros.name: DTLformatauthor
macros.doc: The format of an author’s name.

macros.name: DTLformatauthorlist
macros.doc: Used by styles to format the list of author names (which will be obtained from the Author field).

macros.name: DTLformatbibentry
macros.doc: Formats the current bib entry.

macros.name: DTLformatbibnamelist
macros.doc: Generic formatting command for list of names.

macros.name: DTLformatdate
macros.doc: This is used by the styles to insert the date.

macros.name: DTLformateditor
macros.doc: Formats an editor’s name.

macros.name: DTLformateditorlist
macros.doc: Used by styles to format the list of editor names (which will be obtained from the Editor field).

macros.name: DTLformatforenames
macros.doc: The format of an author/editor’s forenames.

macros.name: DTLformatjr
macros.doc: The format of the “jr” part.

macros.name: DTLformatpages
macros.doc: This is used by the styles to insert the page or page range.

macros.name: DTLformatsurname
macros.doc: The format of an author/editor’s surname.

macros.name: DTLformatsurnameonly
macros.doc: This is used when only the surname should be displayed.

macros.name: DTLformatvon
macros.doc: The format of the “von” part.

macros.name: DTLifanybibfieldexists
macros.doc: Determines whether any of the listed fields exist for the current row of \DTLforeachbibentry.

macros.name: DTLifbibfieldexists
macros.doc: Determines whether the given field name exists for the current row of \DTLforeachbibentry.

macros.name: DTLloadbbl
macros.doc: The commands \DTLloadbbl or \DTLloadmbbl are provided to set the bibliography style to databib, identify the required bib file (or files), create the database and input the bbl file.

macros.name: DTLloadmbbl
macros.doc: The commands \DTLloadbbl or \DTLloadmbbl are provided to set the bibliography style to databib, identify the required bib file (or files), create the database and input the bbl file.

macros.name: DTLmultibibs
macros.doc: This creates an auxiliary file for each name in ⟨list⟩.

macros.name: DTLpostvon
macros.doc: Space to insert after ⟨von part⟩.

macros.name: DTLtwoand
macros.doc: Placed between the two names when the list only contains two names.

envs.name: DTLthebibliography
envs.doc: Formats the bibliography (using thebibliography) according to the current style.
